zh:
AI/UX 實務流：
H+M 省下的 Token · 合成用戶用於POC 階段 · 知識蒸餾的邊界
en:
AI/UX practice flow:
Tokens H+M saves · Synthetic users in the POC phase · The distill boundary

zh: 單場 90 分鐘講座的內容脊梁:以管理三面向收攏設計師的 AI 日常—管資源(Token 帳本)、管流程(合成用戶用於POC 階段)、管邊界(蒸餾的邊界 §05–§07)。 論證核心貫穿全文:一份給 AI 讀的文字檔 ＋ 一份給人看的畫面（markdown＝substrate、html＝view；細節見技術對照）。每節雙層帶走物對位 EPSS;邊界段以判斷→組織問責→制度化物件收束。 受眾為封閉社群(EPSS 0–3)與資源決策者（設計管理者／AI PM）;本文件是講什麼、帶走什麼—不是規劃小組分工表。
en: The spine of this 90-minute talk: three management cuts on a designer's AI day—resources (the Token ledger), process (synthetic users in the POC phase), boundary (the distill boundary, §05–§07). The through-line: one text file for the AI ＋ one screen for humans (markdown＝substrate, html＝view; see the tech counterpart). Each section ends with a two-layer takeaway mapped to EPSS. The boundary block closes as judgment → org accountability → objects you can institutionalize. Audience: a closed community (EPSS 0–3) and resource decision-makers (design managers / AI PMs). This doc is what we say and what you leave with—not a work-split sheet for the planning cell.

zh: 本文件與講座以社群既有的 EPSS 熟練度量表(0–6)校準受眾與帶走物。下面是量表原文。對號入座與 T1 問卷不用這張——用 §01 行為自查表：由上往下，第一個「是」就是你；不要用定義往高的靠。
en: This talk and this doc are calibrated to the community's existing EPSS proficiency scale (0–6). The original scale is below. Do not use it to place yourself or for the T1 survey—use the §01 self-check: top down, the first "yes" is you. Do not climb the definitions toward a higher score.

zh: 90 分鐘 × 三題 × 每節雙層帶走物:讓 EPSS 0–3 的社群成員帶著可照做的步驟卡離場、讓資源決策者（推廣階段期望新帶入的設計管理者/AI PM族群）帶著當週可推行的揭露範本離場
en: 90 minutes × three questions × a two-layer takeaway per section: EPSS 0–3 members leave with step cards they can follow; resource decision-makers (design managers / AI PMs we want in during outreach) leave with a disclosure template they can roll out this week

zh: 三題依「成本 → 方法 → 邊界」排列:§03 Token 帳本(markdown＋html 雙層架構省 token;三個立即可砍的成本項)、§04 合成用戶用於POC 階段(低預算（一人設計創業）的 POC 驗證迴路,demo 預錄)、§05–§07 蒸餾的邊界(矩陣＋揭露範本 → 組織問責 → 制度化物件 D1–D8)。 §05 蒸餾的邊界向後延續為 §06 組織問責 與 §07 制度化物件(D1–D8)—同主題三段:判斷→問責→帶走物。Demo 預錄與成效閉環見 §08–§09。 現場錨點:§04 demo 預錄主線;§05–§07 揭露範本＋問責＋D1–D8。
en: Three questions in cost → method → boundary order: §03 Token ledger (markdown＋html two-layer architecture saves tokens; three costs you can cut now), §04 Synthetic users in the POC phase (a POC validation loop for a low-budget solo design founder; demo is pre-recorded), §05–§07 The distill boundary (matrix ＋ disclosure template → org accountability → institutional objects D1–D8). §05 The distill boundary continues as §06 Org accountability and §07 Institutional objects (D1–D8)—one theme in three beats: judgment → accountability → takeaway. Pre-recorded demo and outcome loop: §08–§09. Live anchors: §04 pre-recorded demo as the through-line; §05–§07 disclosure template ＋ accountability ＋ D1–D8.

zh: 受眾是按月訂閱的封閉社群,成員已固化,拉新漏斗不成立—講座的工作是兩件:對內服務 EPSS 0–3 的既有成員、對外說服資源決策者（推廣階段期望新帶入的設計管理者/AI PM族群）。推廣階段外溢帶到 EPSS 4。 決策者動手能力多在 EPSS 1–2 但握有預算,因此每一節固定收在雙層帶走物:動手層(EPSS 3 能照步驟做、允許犯錯)與決策層(EPSS 1–2 也能帶走的判斷或範本)。EPSS 4（自行排錯）只 Demo、只點到。動手層一律附條列化操作步驟,逐步標注 EPSS 等級。 EPSS 分佈採設計假設開場、課後驗證:現場對位依本節假設。T1 課後問卷(Google Form)於 Day 0 發、D+7 收,餵 §09 成效門檻與下檔校準—不在開場要真實分佈。 T1 的 EPSS 題幹不是「請自評 0–6」,是:「對照附錄第一張自查表,由上往下,第一個『是』是幾。」禁止用定義往高的靠。這是分佈校準,不是成效量測——採購規則「不接受自評數據」仍然成立。
en: Audience is a closed monthly-subscription community. Membership is fixed; there is no acquisition funnel. The talk does two jobs: serve existing EPSS 0–3 members inward, and persuade resource decision-makers outward (design managers / AI PMs we want in during outreach). Outreach spillover reaches EPSS 4. Decision-makers often sit at EPSS 1–2 but hold budget, so every section closes on a two-layer takeaway: hands-on (EPSS 3 can follow the steps and is allowed to fail) and decision (a judgment or template EPSS 1–2 can still leave with). EPSS 4 (debug on your own): demo only, mention only. Hands-on always ships a numbered step list, each step tagged with an EPSS level. EPSS mix is a design hypothesis at open, verified after class: live mapping follows this section's hypothesis. T1 post-class survey (Google Form) goes out Day 0, collected D+7, feeds §09 outcome thresholds and the next-run calibration—do not demand a real distribution at open. T1's EPSS stem is not "self-rate 0–6". It is: "Using the first self-check table in the appendix, top down, which number is your first 'yes.'" No climbing via definitions. This calibrates the mix; it is not an outcome metric—the procurement rule "self-report data is not accepted" still holds.

zh: 社群主體 EPSS 0–3 推廣外溢 EPSS 4 對位課程語言:EPSS 0–3 ≈ Maturity Ladder L0–L1
en: Community core: EPSS 0–3 Outreach spillover: EPSS 4 Course language map: EPSS 0–3 ≈ Maturity Ladder L0–L1

zh: 順序即弧線:成本開場勾住決策者(門檻最低)、demo 在中段製造記憶點(風險最高,放在注意力峰值)、治理收尾給行動項(決策者主場,帶著可推行的東西離場)。點下方三卡直接跳到對應分頁。
en: Order is the arc: open on cost to hook decision-makers (lowest barrier), park the demo mid-talk to plant a memory (highest risk, at peak attention), close on governance with action items (decision-makers' home turf; they leave with something they can roll out). Tap a card below to jump to that tab.

zh: 對決策者最友善的一節,放最前面。全程把 token 換算成錢講(月費額度、API 帳單),不停留在 token 數。 個案方法:用你的教材個案實測 prompt-only vs. context-assisted 的帳單對照—同一個設計任務、兩種 context 策略、兩張帳單,現場攤開。 論證核心:一份給 AI 讀的文字檔 ＋ 一份給人看的畫面,本身就是省 token 的架構—兩份成對放著,下一輪直接引用,不用再貼一次。
en: The friendliest section for decision-makers. Put it first. Convert tokens to money the whole way (monthly quota, API bill). Do not linger on token counts. Case method: run your teaching case as a live prompt-only vs. context-assisted bill comparison—same design task, two context strategies, two bills, open them on stage. The argument: one text file for the AI ＋ one screen for humans is itself a token-saving architecture—keep the pair, cite them next round, do not paste again.

zh: 多數深度工時落在 Claude 問答與 Claude Code;Claude Desktop（桌面版）反而更常是協調節點—排程、對齊、轉交—不是最長的那一段動手時間。
en: Most deep-work hours sit in Claude Q&A and Claude Code. Claude Desktop is more often the coordination node—schedule, align, hand off—not the longest hands-on stretch.

zh: 先講一個你可能正在做的情境:小團隊共用同一個 Claude 帳號(省錢、好交接、對話都在同一個地方)。帳號裡其實早就能放專案檔—這本來就是 S1 的形狀;但現場常同時踩到三層問題:
en: Start with a scene you may already be in: a small team sharing one Claude account (cheaper, easier handoff, all threads in one place). The account can already hold project files—that is already the shape of S1. Live, people still hit three stacked problems:

zh: ① 共用混亂 · COT 與權限各說各話 同事們打開對話框,做的往往還是 S0:A 把 brief 全選複製貼上 → B 換手又貼一次 → C 找不到剛才那版,再貼第三次。 同一份東西被付了三次錢;更關鍵的是每個人腦中的 COT(寫作思維鏈)不同—誰改過、依哪一版、下一步要做什麼,互不同步。 帳號共用也不代表權限相同:有人看得到客戶合約、有人只該看公開 brief,卻用同一個登入全部攤開。
en: ① Shared-account chaos · COT and permissions out of sync Colleagues open the chat and still run S0: A select-all-copies the brief and pastes → B takes over and pastes again → C cannot find that version, pastes a third time. You paid for the same blob three times. Worse: each person's COT (writing chain of thought) is different—who edited, which version, what is next, none of it lines up. Sharing a login is not sharing the same permissions: one person should see the client contract, another should only see the public brief, and the same sign-in dumps everything.

zh: ② 邊界模糊 · 誰看得到、誰轉得出去 共用帳號＝預設所有人看得到彼此的完整對話與附檔(客戶名、未公開稿、合約條件都在裡面)。 若再用 Claude Share 把對話連結轉出去,等於多開一扇門—連結可被轉寄、轉貼,「對內共用」與「對外分享」的邊界一次糊掉,你很難追這串 context 最後落到誰手上。
en: ② Fuzzy boundary · who can see it, who can send it out A shared account means everyone can see everyone else's full threads and attachments by default (client names, unpublished drafts, contract terms, all in there). If you then Claude Share a thread link, you open a second door—the link can be forwarded and pasted. The line between "internal share" and "external Share" collapses in one move, and you cannot trace whose hands this context landed in.

zh: ③ 公域可被搜尋 · Share 曾進索引 Claude Share 連結一旦外流,風險不只是「熟人轉寄」:公網可被搜尋引擎收錄(Google、Bing 等曾可索引到這類分享頁—目前主流引擎多已移除／下架相關結果,但不代表風險歸零:快取、轉載、第三方鏡像、未撤的連結仍可能殘留)。 現場記一句:能 Share,就當可能進公域;不要用「搜不到了」當安全證明。
en: ③ Publicly searchable · Share once hit the index Once a Claude Share link leaks, the risk is not only "a colleague forwarded it": the public web can be indexed (Google, Bing and others once indexed these share pages—most major engines have since dropped / delisted the results, which does not zero the risk: caches, reprints, third-party mirrors, and unrevoked links can still linger). One line for the room: if you can Share it, treat it as public-web-capable. "It no longer shows up in search" is not a safety proof.

zh: 本節只做一件事:共用帳號時,把「同一份真相」變成附檔／Project,而不是每人重貼—並把敏感內容當預設會外洩來管,而不是事後才驚訝。
en: This section does one job: on a shared account, make "one source of truth" an attachment / Project, not a re-paste per person—and govern sensitive content as if it will leak by default, instead of being surprised after the fact.

zh:
自我診斷三問 · 現場舉手 ① 你上次要 AI 看一份文件,是打開檔案、全選複製、貼進對話框嗎?是 → 你在 S0。
② 你有沒有一份固定的檔案,每次開始工作都直接附上或放在 Project 裡,而不是貼內容?有 → 你在 S1。
③ 你有沒有把重複用的判斷做成一份平常不附、需要時才被叫出來的檔案?有 → 你在 S2。
—三題都答「沒有」不代表落後。共用帳號最常見的坑,就是每人還在 S0 重貼—外加彼此對話與 Share 連結的隱私外洩;S0 → S1 是投報率最高的一步:一份附檔,整隊不用再貼。
en:
Self-check, three questions · hands up in the room ① Last time you needed the AI to see a document, did you open the file, select all, copy, paste into the chat? Yes → you are at S0.
② Do you have one fixed file you attach or keep in Project every time you start, instead of pasting the body? Yes → you are at S1.
③ Have you turned a reused judgment into a file you do not attach by default, and only call when needed? Yes → you are at S2.
—Three "no"s is not a lag. The common shared-account trap is everyone still re-pasting at S0—plus privacy leaks from each other's threads and Share links. S0 → S1 is the highest-return step: one attachment, the team stops pasting.

zh: 主講注意:「共用帳號」是好懂的現場情境,不是資安或採購建議—實際應分帳號與權限。三段口播順序固定:① 混亂(COT／權限)→ ② 邊界(Share 轉寄)→ ③ 公域(曾可被 Google／Bing 索引;現多已移除,但殘留風險仍在)。若有人追問機制細節,轉入技術對照版。
en: Speaker note: "shared account" is a legible live scene, not a security or procurement recommendation—in practice, split accounts and permissions. Keep the three-beat spoken order: ① chaos (COT / permissions) → ② boundary (Share forwards) → ③ public web (once indexable by Google / Bing; mostly delisted now, residual risk remains). If someone presses on mechanism, switch to the tech counterpart.

en: What leaves the room is S0 → S1: one attachment, the team stops pasting. S1 → S2 (the system decides when to load) is mention-only; mechanism goes in the tech counterpart below. The three cost items (3.3) are the detail of that move.

en: Mechanism and magnitude sources: Claude official docs, Agent Skills (three-layer progressive disclosure; description is the trigger-match basis). L1/L2 token measurements are third-party stats on the official 17 skills—flag them as third-party in the talk.

zh: 一句話講完:說明書寫的是「應該會怎樣」,你桌上發生的是「實際會怎樣」。 這不是抱怨工具—落差本身就是答案:如果照著官方文件做就會順,那這場講座、這門課都不必存在。 先對一件現場最容易混的事:同一套 Design 能力,在 Claude 問答、Claude Code、Claude Design 三端長得不一樣、用法也不一樣—問答與 Code 吃深工時(見上方泳道);Design 是可視化／POC 畫布端,常跟 Code 用 /design-sync、/design 對接。
en: One sentence: the manual describes "what should happen"; your desk shows "what actually happens." The gap is the point: if following the official docs just worked, this talk and this course would not exist. First, unmix the thing the room most often conflates: the same Design capability looks different—and is used differently—in Claude Q&A, Claude Code, and Claude Design. Q&A and Code eat the deep-work hours (see the swimlane above). Design is the visualization / POC canvas surface, often wired to Code via /design-sync and /design.

zh: 資料夾式清單(accessibility-review、design-critique…)。用法偏「點名這份範本／讓它讀這份」。
en: Folder-style list (accessibility-review, design-critique…). Usage leans "call this template by name / make it read this file."

zh: slash 選單。/de 會同時跳出 debug、design、與 design:… 前綴版—選錯多付 L2。
en: Slash menu. /de surfaces debug, design, and the design:… prefixed variants at once—pick the wrong one and you pay an extra L2.

zh: 獨立產品端(claude.ai/design):用對話＋畫布產出原型、簡報、一頁式視覺;可匯入 design system,並與 Code 雙向同步(/design-sync 拉系統、/design 在 Code 裡開設計、做好可交回 Code 實作)。
en: Standalone product surface (claude.ai/design): chat ＋ canvas to produce prototypes, decks, one-pagers; can import a design system and two-way sync with Code (/design-sync pulls the system, /design opens design inside Code, done work can go back to Code for implementation).

zh: 對講座核心的對位:html view layer（POC 可視化便於溝通）多半在這端發生—但它是後段,不是起點。後段鏈:品牌資產／設計系統約束並強化不同變體的 POC html → 用視覺強度引導動態效果注記(什麼動、多強、何時) → 再進更利於前端落地的框架(Code／元件庫／實作 repo)。缺系統的變體＝模板臉;有注記無判斷＝裝飾動效。
en: Mapped to the talk's core: the html view layer (POC visualization for communication) mostly happens here—and it is the back half, not the start. Back-half chain: brand assets / design system constrain and strengthen variant POC html → use visual intensity to annotate motion (what moves, how hard, when) → then into a framework that lands in front-end (Code / component library / implementation repo). Variants with no system ＝ template-face. Annotation with no judgment ＝ decorative motion.

en: Almost always an explicit / call (including /design, /design-sync)

en: "Type /de first; split bare from design:"—EPSS 3–4; prefix your own skills pux-*

en: "substrate → brand / system → variant POC html → motion notes → front-end framework"—view is the back half. Do not open Design on a blank canvas

zh:
為何不建議直接從 Claude Design（與同族 Design＋Build）開始 講座順序是 UX documents → UI,不是 空白畫布 → 看起來像 UI。Claude Design 擅長把已定稿的概念組合畫出來;若缺設計判斷的關鍵組件定義,它會用幻覺把組合補完—畫面完整,判斷空洞。

所謂關鍵組件,至少包含:頁面(page)、模組(module)、流程(flow)。其中最容易漏、也最容易幻覺的是不可見的 Agent 協作流程—人與人、人與 agent、agent 與 agent 之間誰先動、讀什麼、寫回哪、失敗怎麼接手。這些不會出現在漂亮的 UI 幀上,卻決定產品能不能跑。

功能／模組清單		 發明不存在的功能、重複造輪子、或把兩個模組糊成一個漂亮區塊
Page list
頁面清單		 亂增頁、漏頁、同名異頁;導覽看起來完整,實際對不上要做的頁
Information architecture
資訊架構		 分類與命名靠模型套話;階層亂跳、標籤同義詞分裂、找不到東西卻到處是入口
另外三個產品層坑仍在:① 沒 schema 只有畫面,下一輪又從頭描述;② 未 /design-sync／未匯入品牌資產·設計系統就變模板臉;③ 與 Code 脫鉤後 handoff 變截圖重做(動效若只存在於口頭,前端落地同樣失敗)。
一人設計創業的低預算打法:問答／Project 先把 page · module · use flow · Agent 協作流程 · IA 寫進 markdown substrate（文字版 COT）→ 品牌資產／設計系統約束變體 → Design／html 產出可溝通的 POC view,並以視覺強度寫清動態效果注記 → 再進利於前端落地的框架(Code／元件庫)。html view layer 多半在這後段發生—Design 放大的是判斷,不是用來代替判斷,也不是起點。

現場反方 · 很多工作仍是 Screenshot／Template／Prompt → Figma

別裝了，現場大家都在用 Mobbin 截圖、套模板、打 Prompt 丟 Figma。這條探索路徑沒有消失，我們也不禁。Claude Design、Genspark Design、Replit Design 甚至把這條路縮短成 Design＋Build（畫完一鍵變 App／code）。

講座不反對你用它來快速探索 MVP。我們要釘死的是下一手：禁止把漂亮的 frame 綑綁反解成 Design.md 和 tokens，假裝這叫設計系統！

動作 可以 別當成
Screenshot／Mobbin 找靈感、對 pattern、寫進證據層（app·flow·url·analog／gap） 直接抽成自家 tokens；或複製成「我們的 Design system」
Template／Prompt 早期並排比方向、少一點空白焦慮 產品決策本身；模板≠品牌策略，Prompt≠page／module／flow 定稿
進 Figma／Design 畫布 Tier C 視覺本體、原型溝通、精修 1 個勝出方向 補寫沒做過的判斷；多方案整包當交付
Design＋Build 選定方向後進可測 MVP；少一次「截圖重做」交接 畫面好看＝已上線；跳過研究／a11y／QA／權限與資料邊界

為何不建議「畫面 → 綑綁解析 → Design.md ＋ tokens」

Design.md 與 tokens 的價值是下一輪可引用的約束（輸入），不是上一輪輸出的回聲。從 frame 反解，等於把輸出洗成輸入，把 AI 的幻覺洗成真相源：

一鍵反解只會得到沒有語意、沒有使用條件、沒有狀態對照的色票與間距數字。第 10 頁、第 3 人加入後，系統立刻各長一套。這不叫系統，這叫「用速度掩蓋未做的判斷」，一接真實資料、登入、付款立刻破功。

記一句：先約束再生成＝Design.md／tokens 當輸入；先生成再反解＝把輸出洗成輸入。後者會自我強化偏誤—下一輪 Ambient 變體都在回聲裡集體退化。允許的寫回是人工策展：勝出方向裡，人決定哪幾條判斷進 Design.md，哪幾個 token 進 tokens.json；不是一鍵「從 frame 匯出系統」。

三家 Design＋Build 大白話對位

三家共同賣點都是少一次失真交接（畫完一鍵變 App／code）。這對 PM、創業者做 MVP 確實有用。但要釘死官方也承認的邊界：Design＝視覺原型；Build／Code＝資料、登入、付款、外部服務。適合加速探索，不是跳過設計審核與 QA。

產品 它強在哪 講座怎麼接
Claude Design 畫布＋對話出 POC；可匯入 design system；與 Code 經 /design-sync、/design 對接 後段 view；缺 page·module·flow·Agent 協作流程就別開畫布
Genspark Design 對話到 prototype／多格式；可套 Design System；一鍵 Build it 出可跑 code 「Build it」解的是實作距離，不解判斷距離；Verifier≠用戶研究
Replit Design Prompt／Template／Figma／Claude／URL／Screenshot／Design system 起手；Ambient Intelligence 提下一步；內建 Mobbin；Design→同專案 Build Mobbin＝靈感／證據，不是 tokens 來源；Ambient 增選項不增決策；frame→App 仍要 Core／Pro 與真實測試

給 EPSS 0–2 · Replit Design 白話拆解

沒碰過 Replit Design 沒關係，把它想成「一個能把點子很快變成能點的畫面、再一鍵變成能跑的小程式」的工具。六個重點，用白話講：

功能 白話講
很多種起手方式 不用從空白開始。你可以丟一段 Prompt、套一個 Template、匯入 Figma、貼 Claude 產出的 html、給一個 URL、丟一張 Screenshot，甚至直接吃你的 Design system。
Ambient Intelligence 它會看著你現在的畫面，主動建議「下一個變體」「下一步可以做什麼」—你不用每次都重打一遍 Prompt。
內建 Mobbin 靈感庫 超過 60 萬個真實產品畫面可以直接參考，不用自己跳出去找截圖。
Design ≠ Build Design 階段只出視覺原型（畫面好看、按鈕能點，但沒有真的資料）。要變成能跑的 App（接資料、登入、付款、外部服務）要進 Build—那是另一段。
方案差異 大部分 Design 功能各方案都能用；但要把 design frame 真的建成一個新 App，需要 Core 或 Pro 方案。
適合誰 PM、創業者、小團隊加速 MVP。是「快一點看到東西」的工具，不是跳過設計審核與 QA 的捷徑。

一句話收束：Design 出畫面、Build 才能跑；加速 MVP，不等於跳過審核。來源見講綱資料註。

給 EPSS 0–2 · Replit Design 的五種起點

「可以從很多地方開始」聽起來抽象，拆成五種實際做法就清楚了：

起點 白話講
① 直接描述 用一句話講出想做什麼—網站、App、海報、社群貼文、產品原型都行。不用先畫。
② 套 Template 從 Replit 內建的模板挑一個改。適合「有參考就不空白焦慮」的人。
③ 匯入 Figma／Claude 已經在別的地方畫好了，直接搬進來繼續改，不用重畫。
④ 給 URL 或 Screenshot 看到一個喜歡的網站或畫面，貼網址或截圖，它幫你重建方向。
⑤ 套 Design system 已經有品牌規範，新畫面一開始就符合—不用事後調色調字。

什麼時候用 Design 起手？外觀方向還不確定，需要先看見選項的時候。如果你的核心難題是產品行為、資料結構、串接外部服務，那直接從 Build 開始反而更有效率—先讓東西跑起來，畫面之後再調。
en:
Why not start from Claude Design (or same-family Design＋Build) Talk order is UX documents → UI, not blank canvas → something that looks like UI. Claude Design is good at drawing a locked concept combo. If the key components of the design judgment are undefined, it hallucinates the rest—the screen is complete, the judgment is hollow.

Those key components at least include: page, module, flow. The one most often missing—and most often hallucinated—is the invisible Agent collaboration flow: between people, person and agent, agent and agent, who moves first, what they read, where they write back, who picks up on failure. None of that shows up on a pretty UI frame. All of it decides whether the product can run.

Start from Design and hallucination fills whatever definition you skipped:
Missing definition Typical Design-side hallucination
Use flow
Visible user task path		 Buttons exist, task order does not; skipped gates, dead ends, or "every page can do everything"
Agent collaboration flow
Invisible handoff / trigger / write-back		 UI pretends "one-click done"; who moves first, where it writes back, who picks up on failure—undefined. Demo is clickable, the system cannot be wired; or it invents automation that does not exist
Module list
Feature / module inventory		 Invented features, rebuilt wheels, or two modules mashed into one pretty block
Page list
Page inventory		 Extra pages, missing pages, same name different page; nav looks complete, it does not map to the pages you must ship
Information architecture
Information architecture		 Labels and grouping come from model boilerplate; hierarchy jumps, synonym-split tags, you cannot find the thing yet every surface is an entry
Three product-layer traps remain: ① no schema, only screens, so the next round you describe it from scratch again; ② skip /design-sync / skip importing brand assets · design system and you get template-face; ③ unhook from Code and handoff becomes screenshot-rebuild (if motion lives only in speech, front-end landing fails the same way).
Low-budget move for a solo design founder: in Q&A / Project, write page · module · use flow · Agent collaboration flow · IA into the markdown substrate first (text COT) → brand assets / design system constrain variants → Design / html produce a communicable POC view, with motion notes tied to visual intensity → then into a framework that lands in front-end (Code / component library). The html view layer mostly happens in this back half—Design amplifies judgment; it does not replace it, and it is not the start.

Live counter · a lot of work is still Screenshot / Template / Prompt → Figma

Stop pretending. In the room, people pull Mobbin screenshots, drop templates, and prompt into Figma. That exploration path did not die, and we do not ban it. Claude Design, Genspark Design, Replit Design even shorten it into Design＋Build (draw it, one-click to App / code).

The talk does not stop you using it to explore an MVP fast. What we nail down is the next move: do not reverse-parse a pretty frame into Design.md and tokens and call that a design system.

Move Allowed Do not treat as
Screenshot／Mobbin Find references, match patterns, write into the evidence layer (app·flow·url·analog／gap) Extracting your own tokens; or copying it as "our Design system"
Template／Prompt Early side-by-side direction, less blank-canvas freeze The product decision itself; a template ≠ brand strategy, a Prompt ≠ a locked page／module／flow
Into Figma／Design canvas Tier C visual body, prototype communication, polish 1 winning direction Backfilling judgment you never made; shipping a bundle of options as the deliverable
Design＋Build After a direction is picked, a testable MVP; one fewer "screenshot-rebuild" handoff Pretty screen ＝ shipped; skipping research／a11y／QA／permission and data boundaries

Why not "screen → bundled reverse-parse → Design.md ＋ tokens"

The value of Design.md and tokens is constraint you can cite next round (input), not an echo of last round's output. Reverse-parsing a frame means laundering output into input, laundering the AI's hallucination into a source of truth:

One-click reverse-parse gives you swatches and spacing numbers with no semantics, no use conditions, no state mapping. By page 10, once a third person joins, each person grows a different system. That is not a system. That is speed covering unmade judgment. Hook up real data, login, or payment and it breaks.

One line: constrain then generate ＝ Design.md／tokens as input; generate then reverse-parse ＝ launder output into input. The latter self-reinforces bias—the next Ambient variants all degrade together inside the echo. The write-back we allow is human curation: in the winning direction, a person decides which judgments enter Design.md and which tokens enter tokens.json. Not one-click "export a system from the frame."

Three Design＋Build products, plain mapping

The shared pitch is one fewer distorted handoff (draw it, one-click to App / code). Useful for PMs and founders shipping an MVP. Nail the boundary the vendors also admit: Design＝visual prototype; Build／Code＝data, login, payment, external services. Speeds exploration. Does not skip design review and QA.

Product Where it is strong How this talk uses it
Claude Design Canvas ＋ chat for a POC; can import a design system; wires to Code via /design-sync, /design Back-half view; skip the canvas if page·module·flow·Agent collaboration flow are missing
Genspark Design Chat to prototype / multi-format; can apply a Design System; one-click Build it to runnable code "Build it" closes implementation distance, not judgment distance; Verifier≠user research
Replit Design Start from Prompt／Template／Figma／Claude／URL／Screenshot／Design system; Ambient Intelligence suggests next; built-in Mobbin; Design→Build in the same project Mobbin＝reference / evidence, not a tokens source; Ambient adds options, not decisions; frame→App still needs Core／Pro and real tests

For EPSS 0–2 · Replit Design in plain language

If you have never opened Replit Design, treat it as a tool that turns an idea into a clickable screen fast, then one-click into a small runnable program. Six points, in plain language:

Feature In plain language
Many ways to start You do not start from blank. Drop a Prompt, apply a Template, import Figma, paste Claude-generated html, give a URL, drop a Screenshot, or feed it your Design system.
Ambient Intelligence It watches the current screen and suggests "the next variant" and "what you could do next"—you do not retype the Prompt every round.
Built-in Mobbin library 600k+ real product screens to reference in place. You do not leave to hunt screenshots.
Design ≠ Build The Design phase only produces a visual prototype (the screen looks good, buttons click, there is no real data). To become a runnable App (data, login, payment, external services) you enter Build—that is a separate stretch.
Plan differences Most Design features work on every plan. Turning a design frame into a new App requires Core or Pro.
Who it is for PMs, founders, small teams accelerating an MVP. A "see something sooner" tool. It is not a shortcut around design review and QA.

One-line close: Design makes the screen; Build makes it run. Faster MVP does not mean skip review. Sources in the talk notes.

For EPSS 0–2 · five starting points in Replit Design

"You can start from many places" is abstract. Five actual moves make it concrete:

Start In plain language
① Describe it Say in one sentence what you want—site, App, poster, social post, product prototype. No drawing first.
② Apply a Template Pick a built-in Replit template and edit. For people who freeze on a blank canvas if they have nothing to push against.
③ Import Figma／Claude You already drew it elsewhere. Bring it in and keep editing. Do not redraw.
④ Give a URL or Screenshot See a site or screen you like, paste the URL or screenshot, and it reconstructs a direction.
⑤ Apply a Design system You already have brand rules. New screens match from the first frame—no post-hoc color and type chase.

When do you start in Design? When visual direction is still open and you need to see options. If the hard problem is product behavior, data structure, wiring external services, start in Build—get it running, tune the screen later.

zh:
動手層 · Hands-on · EPSS 3
先把 S0 升到 S1(步驟卡 A):建一份給 AI 讀的文字檔,養成「附檔不重貼」。S2 只點到—有跨專案重複的判斷再談。
決策層 · Decision · EPSS 1–2
帶走三個立即可砍的成本項:重貼、重造、整塞,以及一句盤點問題:「我們的團隊停在 S0 還是 S1?」—停在 S0 的團隊,買再多工具也省不下來。另帶走 3.4 的採購規則:不接受自評數據作為導入依據。
en:
Hands-on layer · Hands-on · EPSS 3
Lift S0 to S1 first (step card A): make one text file for the AI to read, and make "attach, do not re-paste" the habit. S2 is mention-only—raise it when a judgment repeats across projects.
Decision layer · Decision · EPSS 1–2
Leave with three costs you can cut now: re-paste, rebuild, stuff-it-all-in, plus one inventory question: "Is this team stuck at S0 or S1?"—an S0 team does not save money by buying more tools. Also leave with the 3.4 procurement rule: self-report data is not accepted as an adoption basis.

zh: 開一個專案資料夾,建立 project.md—這一份檔案就是你的 substrate（文字版 COT·與 LLM 協作的寫作思維鏈）。
en: Open a project folder. Create project.md—that file is your substrate (text COT · the writing chain of thought you share with the LLM).

zh: 把 spec、design tokens、關鍵決策分成三段貼進去,各加一行標題(## Spec / ## Tokens / ## Decisions)。不求完整,先求有。
en: Paste spec, design tokens, and key decisions as three blocks, each with a heading (## Spec / ## Tokens / ## Decisions). Completeness can wait. Existence cannot.

zh: 之後每次開新對話,第一個動作是附上 project.md(與需要的 html view),並說「先讀這些」—從此不再把同一段內文重貼進對話。 忘了附檔、又開始重貼,是最常見的退化;把附檔做成對話的固定開場。
en: Every new thread, first action: attach project.md (and the html view you need) and say "read these first"—never re-paste the same body into the chat again. Forgetting the attachment and re-pasting is the usual regression. Make the attachment the fixed opening of the thread.

zh: 每輪對話結束,把有效的新決策寫回 project.md(可以請 AI 幫你濃縮成 2–3 行再貼回)。 分不清哪些值得寫回?先只寫「下次對話還會用到的結論」。
en: At the end of each round, write back the decisions that still hold into project.md (you can ask the AI to compress them to 2–3 lines, then paste). Unsure what is worth writing back? Write only "conclusions the next thread will still use."

zh: 先找候選:你在三個以上不同專案重複貼的同一段判斷。只出現一次的東西留在 substrate 就好。 找不到候選,代表你還在 S1 的收益區—不必急著升級。
en: Find candidates first: the same judgment you have pasted across three or more projects. One-off material stays in the substrate. No candidates means you are still in S1's return zone—do not rush the upgrade.

zh: 建 SKILL.md,frontmatter 寫 name 與 description。description 同時交代做什麼 + 何時用—這是模型判斷要不要觸發的唯一依據。 描述裡出現「等」「相關」「各種」這類模糊詞,就是誤觸發的來源。
en: Create SKILL.md. In frontmatter write name and description. The description must state what it does + when to use it—that is the model's only basis for whether to trigger. Fuzzy words like "etc.," "related," "various" in the description are how false triggers start.

zh: 命名加自有前綴(如 pux-audit),避開與既有 plugin 的前綴競爭—打 / 時能一眼認出哪個是自己的。
en: Prefix the name (e.g. pux-audit) so it does not compete with existing plugin prefixes—when you type / you can see which one is yours.

zh:
白話版 · 一句話 · 現場主講用 你不會用「我覺得這個介面很好用」來結束一場易用性測試。那為什麼要用「我覺得快多了」來結束一次工具評估?
—我們對別人的產品要求證據,對自己的工作方法卻只用感覺。這一節就是把你已經有的研究紀律,套用在自己身上。
en:
Plain version · one sentence · for the speaker You would not close a usability test with "I feel this interface is easy." Why close a tool evaluation with "I feel faster"?
—We demand evidence for other people's products and run our own methods on feeling. This section puts the research discipline you already have onto yourself.

zh: 兩件事要分清楚:「這個功能怎麼運作」去看官方說明書(那是他們做的,可信);「用了省多少、快多少」要問是誰量的、量的是什麼。網路上流傳的數字多半是後者,而且轉手幾次之後就找不到出處了。 有一份研究值得知道:資深工程師在自己熟悉的專案上用 AI 工具,實際上變慢了,但他們事後仍然覺得自己變快—感覺跟碼錶不一致。這份研究自己也聲明不能推論到所有情境,所以結論不是「AI 沒用」,而是感覺不能當數據用。
en: Split two claims: "how this feature works" goes to the official manual (they built it; that is trustworthy). "how much you save, how much faster" needs who measured it and what they measured. Most numbers circulating online are the second kind, and after a few retellings the source is gone. One study worth knowing: senior engineers using AI tools on a codebase they already knew actually got slower, and still felt faster afterward—feeling and the stopwatch disagreed. The study itself says you cannot generalize to every setting. Treat it as a stopwatch warning: feeling is not data.

zh: 風險換方向了,不是變小:低等級的風險在接收端(信錯別人的數字),高等級的風險在產出端(自己變成錯誤數字的來源)—交叉點正是 EPSS 3。對號入座用投影片附錄第一張自查表,不是七列定義。
en: Risk changed direction; it did not shrink. Low-level risk sits on the receiving end (believing someone else's numbers). High-level risk sits on the producing end (you become the source of bad numbers)—the crossover is EPSS 3. Place yourself with the first self-check table in the slide appendix, not the seven-row definitions.

zh: 完整版:官方文件與社群經驗多數時候不是矛盾,是主張層級不同—官方講機制(怎麼載入、怎麼觸發),社群講效果(省了多少、快了多少)。問題不在誰對,在於社群把機制陳述當成效果承諾轉述,數字在轉手中失去出處。 真正的衝突只有一處值得講:一份隨機對照試驗發現,資深開發者在熟悉的程式庫上使用 AI 工具反而變慢,而他們事後仍認為自己變快了—感知與量測之間存在持續落差。該研究同時聲明不代表其他情境無效,後續實驗也因參與者選擇偏誤而難以解讀。 所以結論不是「AI 沒用」,而是自評不能替代量測。這正是 T3 帳單對照存在的理由:同一套方法論,不同尺度。
en: Full version: official docs and community lore usually do not contradict; they claim at different layers—officials talk mechanism (how it loads, how it triggers), community talks effect (how much you saved, how much faster). The failure is not who is right. It is community retelling a mechanism statement as an effect promise, and numbers losing their source in transit. One real conflict is worth the airtime: an RCT found senior developers using AI tools on a familiar repo got slower, and still believed they got faster—a persistent gap between perception and measurement. The study also says this does not prove other settings fail; follow-on experiments are hard to read because of selection bias. Self-report does not replace measurement. That is why the T3 bill comparison exists: same method, different scale.

zh: 來源分層引用原則—機制引官方、效果引自己實測、判斷引研究。講座中提及的第三方研究須點名出處與其自述限制,不可只取結論。可補充的收斂觀察:近期 UX 研究界已將設計產出描述為「引導 AI 的策展式脈絡」與「把設計判斷編碼為明確評估標準」,與 context engineering 的主張正在靠攏—此點為課程定位論證,非講座必講。
en: Source-layer citation rule—mechanism from official docs, effect from your own measurement, judgment from research. Third-party studies named in the talk must be cited with their self-stated limits; do not lift the conclusion alone. Optional convergence note: recent UX research describes design output as "curated context that steers AI" and "design judgment encoded as explicit evaluation criteria," which is moving toward context engineering—this is a course-positioning argument, not required in the talk.

zh: 決策軌 · 聽完隔天可制度化 不接受自評數據作為採購或導入依據。當供應商或內部團隊聲稱效率提升時,要求提供對照方式與失敗案例;拿不出來的,一律視為未量測。 —這是本講座給決策者的第二個制度化工具(第一個是 §05 的揭露範本),握有的槓桿是預算,不是動手能力。
en: Decision track · institutionalize the day after Do not accept self-report data as a basis for purchase or adoption. When a vendor or an internal team claims an efficiency gain, demand the comparison method and the failure cases. If they cannot produce them, treat it as unmeasured. —This is the talk's second institutional tool for decision-makers (the first is the §05 disclosure template). The lever you hold is budget, not hands-on skill.

en: The section most likely to drown EPSS 0–3. Cut the load hard: turn the whole loop from "teaching" into a demo narrative. No step-by-step instruction. State the premise: in the POC phase there is no external synthetic persona data. You only have a thin pile of your own cases—that is the actual condition for a solo design founder and a low-research-budget team.

zh: 把一個典型產品設計專案六個 Sprint 內的 UX 活動全部攤開——28 種文件、8 個階段。重點不是「設計師有多忙」，而是要回答：如果設計師日常產出有 28 種文件，哪些可以被 AI 結構化、哪些必須留在 Figma？結論：86% 是 markdown 主導的結構化知識，只有 14% 是視覺/空間為主的 Figma 原生文件。合成用戶用於POC 階段的迴路，前置吃的就是這 86%（Tier A＋B）；沒有它們，瀏覽器 agent 產出便缺乏可依循的脈絡依據。
en: Spread every UX activity inside a typical six-Sprint product design project—28 document types, 8 stages. The point is not "designers are busy." The question is: if everyday design output is 28 document types, which ones can AI structure, and which must stay in Figma? Result: 86% is markdown-led structured knowledge; only 14% is visual/spatial Figma-native. The synthetic-user POC loop eats that 86% first (Tier A＋B). Without it, the browser agent's output has no context to follow.

補述 · Design.md／Design system／Design tokens 到哪了？ 三件事常被混成「設計系統」一口袋—分層要拆開講：

① Design tokens→ Tier A（甘特「系統 · 持續維護」列）。落點是 wiki/tokens.md＋機器可讀的 tokens.json：色／字／間距的真相源在 markdown／JSON，不是只活在 Figma 變數面板。
② Design.md→ Tier A。這是給 agent／團隊讀的設計判斷與系統說明 substrate（用什麼棧、品牌約束、元件怎麼取用、什麼時候同步 Design／Code）。它不是畫面檔；缺它，§03 講的「先有系統再進 Design 出 view」就沒有可附的那份檔。
③ Design system→ 跨 Tier，不是單層。規則、tokens、使用說明、命名進 Tier A（含 Design.md）；元件視覺、變體、原型畫布進 Tier C（Figma／Pencil）。跨層靠 wiki 的 component metadata 對得上 Figma 名稱—否則 agent 讀得到 tokens，對不到畫面。

記一句：tokens 與 Design.md 管「可被引用的約束」；Figma 管「看得見的系統本體」。合成用戶 demo 驗證行為形狀時，原料仍應對得上 Tier A／B；Tier C 可以晚到，但 metadata 不能不回 wiki。

與 §03 對齊：Screenshot／Template／Prompt → Figma／Design＋Build 可以拿來探索；別把勝出 frame 一鍵反解成 Design.md／tokens 當真相—那是把輸出洗成輸入。要寫回就人工挑；Mobbin 進證據層，別進 tokens。
en:
Addendum · where did Design.md / Design system / Design tokens go? Three things get mashed into one pocket labeled "design system"—split the layers:

① Design tokens→ Tier A (Gantt row "system · ongoing maintenance"). They live in wiki/tokens.md＋machine-readable tokens.json: the source of truth for color / type / spacing is markdown／JSON, not only the Figma variables panel.
② Design.md→ Tier A. This is the design-judgment and system-notes substrate for agent／team (what stack, brand constraints, how to pick components, when to sync Design／Code). It is not a screen file. Without it, §03's "system first, then Design for the view" has nothing to attach.
③ Design system→ cross-Tier, not one layer. Rules, tokens, usage notes, naming go to Tier A (including Design.md). Component visuals, variants, prototype canvas go to Tier C (Figma／Pencil). Cross-layer match depends on wiki component metadata lining up with Figma names—otherwise the agent can read tokens and cannot hit the screen.

One line: tokens and Design.md govern "citable constraint"; Figma governs "the visible system body". When a synthetic-user demo validates the shape of behavior, raw material should still map to Tier A／B. Tier C can arrive late. Metadata still has to return to the wiki.

Aligned with §03: Screenshot／Template／Prompt → Figma／Design＋Build is fine for exploration. Do not one-click reverse-parse a winning frame into Design.md／tokens as truth—that launders output into input. Write-back is human pick. Mobbin goes into the evidence layer, not into tokens.

Check matrix row two · gray band needs a license

zh: R Responsible 執行 · A Accountable 問責(每列僅一) · C Consulted 諮詢 · I Informed 知會
en: R Responsible · A Accountable (one per row) · C Consulted · I Informed

zh:
動手層 · Hands-on · EPSS 3
把上表改成你團隊的職稱,標出每一列的 A 人名;找不到 A 的那一列,本週先空著也要寫「待指定」—空欄比假 A 誠實。
決策層 · Decision · EPSS 0+
先指定兩格 A:「揭露範本推行」與「專案交付附揭露聲明」。其餘可下周補;這兩格沒主人,§05 的範本不會自己長進制度。
en:
Hands-on layer · Hands-on · EPSS 3
Rewrite the table with your team's titles. Put a named A on every row. If you cannot find an A this week, leave it blank and write "TBD"—an empty cell is more honest than a fake A.
Decision layer · Decision · EPSS 0+
Name two A's first: "roll out the disclosure template" and "project delivery includes a disclosure statement." The rest can wait until next week. If those two cells have no owner, the §05 template will not grow into a system by itself.

zh: 延續 §05／§06:不是講座製作的 T1–T10 時程表,是你離場後能放進 wiki／合約／交付檢核的物件清單。脊梁仍是揭露四欄—每個物件最終都要能回答「工具、資料、人工把關、蒸餾聲明」至少一欄。
en: Continues §05／§06: after you leave, an object list you can drop into wiki／contracts／delivery checklists. Distinct from the talk's T1–T10 timeline. The spine is still the four disclosure columns—every object must eventually answer at least one of "tools, data, human gate, distill statement."

zh:
動手層 · Hands-on · EPSS 3
今晚只做 D2→D3:用四欄填你手上專案;填不出的欄＝治理盲點。明天把 D4 加進筆記模板。
決策層 · Decision · EPSS 0+
當週制度化最小集 = D2＋D5＋D6:範本進檢核、合約寫義務、問責表指定 A。D1／D8 掛決策牆即可,不必等完美 SOP。
en:
Hands-on layer · Hands-on · EPSS 3
Tonight only D2→D3: fill the four columns for a live project. A column you cannot fill ＝ a governance blind spot. Tomorrow add D4 to the note template.
Decision layer · Decision · EPSS 0+
Minimum set to institutionalize this week = D2＋D5＋D6: template on the checklist, duty in the contract, A named on the accountability table. Hang D1／D8 on the decision wall. Do not wait for a perfect SOP.

zh: §05–§07 處理的是知識歸屬取決於身份、誰問責、以及揭露範本推行。7.1–7.3 則回答決策者下一個問題：寫進 wiki 與 prompt corpus 的那些「設計判斷」是如何產生的。串起來就是：功能如何落實為具體產品形態、多方案如何篩選、決策怎麼留存—進而決定如何蒸餾與揭露。
en: §05–§07 handle knowledge belonging according to role, who is accountable, and rolling out the disclosure template. 7.1–7.3 answer the decision-maker's next question: how those "design judgments" written into the wiki and prompt corpus get made. String it: how a feature becomes a concrete product form, how options get screened, how decisions get kept—and therefore how you distill and disclose.

zh: 以「通知管理」為例：PRD 可能只寫「使用者可以管理通知」。這句話放到手機 App、網站、後台、對話助手，會長成完全不同的畫面語言。與 AI 協作時，必須先指定產品形態與對應的介面慣例，否則生成結果容易產生平台特性的混雜。
en: Take notification settings: a PRD may only say "the user can manage notifications." Drop that sentence onto a phone App, a website, an admin, a conversational assistant, and you get entirely different screen languages. When you work with AI, specify the product form and its UI conventions first, or the generation mixes platform traits.

zh: AI 的價值常常不是「一次給對」，而是「一次給很多」。但很多方案不會自己變成決策—你需要一條可重複的流程，把它們收成可審閱、可追溯的選擇。真正的設計判斷在第 4 步：那是 AI 替不了你的地方。
en: AI's usual yield is many options on the first pass. Those options still need a repeatable process that folds them into a choice that is reviewable and traceable. The actual design judgment is step 4: that is the part AI cannot do for you.

zh:
POC
到底在做什麼
核心邏輯在於由 AI 快速產出多種提案，並由設計師進行判斷收斂。前期甘特圖中偏早的段落（約 S0–S2）之所以不可或缺，是因人／情境／案例（Tier A）必須先行確立，第 2 步才能準確指引平台形態；同時旅程／流程（Tier B）成形後，多變體生成才有明確的對照基準。

如果缺乏前期的結構化文件（如 Tier A 與 Tier B），生成變體時容易流於盲目拼湊。實務上的 POC 是將「結構化前置、AI 方案生成、設計判準收斂」三者結合，否則成果往往淪為空洞、缺乏邏輯的視覺草稿。
en:
What a
POC is actually doing
The core loop: AI produces many proposals fast; the designer judges and converges. The early Gantt stretch (about S0–S2) is required because people / situations / cases (Tier A) must be set before step 2 can point at a platform form; and once journey / flow (Tier B) exists, multi-variant generation has a baseline to compare against.

Without those early structured documents (Tier A and Tier B), generated variants drift into collage. A working POC joins three things: structured prep, AI option generation, design-criteria convergence. Skip any and you get hollow visual drafts with no logic.

zh: 此處與「知識蒸餾邊界」直接對應：寫入 wiki 與 prompt corpus 的知識歸屬取決於當下身份（如受僱、外包接案或自有智慧財產權）。7.1–7.3 確立了設計決策的產出流程，而 §05–§07 規範這些成果能否納入長期語料庫並進行適當揭露。兩者互為表裡，否則合規流程將流於形式。
en: This maps straight onto the distill boundary: knowledge written into the wiki and prompt corpus belongs according to the role you hold now (employee, contractor, or your own IP). 7.1–7.3 set how design decisions get produced. §05–§07 set whether those outputs may enter a long-term corpus and how they must be disclosed. They are two sides of one thing. Without both, compliance is paperwork.

zh:
動手層 · EPSS 3–5
下一個功能跑完 7.2 第 5 步後，立刻在筆記加 distill: free | licensed | forbidden，並用 D2 四欄各填一句（工具含產品形態、資料流、誰審、蒸餾範圍）。
決策層 · EPSS 0+
制度句：組織不接受「只有漂亮 variants、沒有決策紀錄」的交付。發包／內部結案必附揭露聲明；決策日誌是可審計物件，不是個人習慣。零技術門檻—你要的是欄位與問責，不是會不會寫 prompt。
en:
Hands-on layer · EPSS 3–5
After the next feature clears 7.2 step 5, add distill: free | licensed | forbidden to the note immediately, and fill one sentence in each of D2's four columns (tools including product form, data flow, who reviewed, distill scope).
Decision layer · EPSS 0+
Institutional line: the org does not accept delivery that is "pretty variants, no decision log." RFPs / internal close-out must attach a disclosure statement. The decision log is an auditable object, not a personal habit. Zero technical barrier—you want fields and accountability, not prompt skill.

zh: 收束 · 決策者主場 設計判斷的留存由 7.1–7.3 的流程與日誌負責，而這些成果能否納入長期語料庫並對外披露，則受 §05–§07 的矩陣與範本規範。有了「7.2 決策日誌」提供真實的決策依據，揭露範本第四欄的蒸餾聲明才能真正落實，否則只是形式上的欄位填寫。
en: Close · decision-makers' home turf Keeping design judgment is the job of the 7.1–7.3 process and log. Whether those outputs may enter a long-term corpus and be disclosed outward is governed by the §05–§07 matrix and template. The "7.2 decision log" supplies the actual basis; only then can column four of the disclosure template—the distill statement—hold. Otherwise it is a form field.

zh: 北美 Product Designer 角色往往一人涵蓋研究、資訊架構與介面設計；亞洲團隊則多採用 PM、UR、UI 與視覺分工明確的流程。不論組織架構如何演變，底層皆共用同一套 Wiki、Agent 與 Schema 機制，僅有職能邊界切分與治理密度的差別。
en: A North American Product Designer often covers research, information architecture, and interface design in one person. Asian teams more often split PM, UR, UI, and visual with hard lanes. Whatever the org chart, the substrate is the same Wiki, Agent, and Schema. What changes is where function lines are cut and how dense the governance is.

zh: 個人 scratchpad + 對工程的 handoff。personas/ 與 decisions/ 主要寫給未來的自己
en: Personal scratchpad + handoff to engineering. personas/ and decisions/ are mostly written for future you

zh: 各 role own 切片—UR→research/、UI→components/、PMD→decisions/、文案→copy/。Schema 統一、ownership 明確
en: Each role owns a slice—UR→research/, UI→components/, PMD→decisions/, copy→copy/. Schema is shared; ownership is explicit

zh: 作品集展你的判斷與方法，不是 AI 產出。force multiplier 更要標清：哪些是你選的、哪些是模型生成—對得上揭露「審核／蒸餾」欄。decisions/ 寫給未來的自己；沒 log＝休假回來自己也蒸餾不出第四欄。
en: A portfolio shows your judgment and method, not AI output. A force multiplier needs the split even more: what you chose vs. what the model generated—mapped to the disclosure "review / distill" column. decisions/ is written for future you. No log＝after vacation you cannot distill column four either.

zh: 作品集只能主張你 own 的切片；跨 role 決策不能偷渡成個人功勞。owner 欄＝作品集與揭露審核欄的同一條線。AI 當 glue 時，一致性檢查結果要寫進 shared log，不是嘴說「大家一起做的」。
en: A portfolio can only claim the slice you own. Cross-role decisions cannot be smuggled in as personal credit. The owner field ＝ the same line as the portfolio and the disclosure review column. When AI is glue, write consistency-check results into a shared log. Do not say "we all did it."

zh: 就算一人，受僱／接案身份仍吃邊界矩陣：個人 scratchpad ≠ 公司 corpus；對工程的 handoff 要能回答誰能讀、誰能帶走。失敗模式是「context 全在腦袋」—共享還沒開始就已經是灰色拷貝。
en: Even solo, employee / contractor identity still hits the boundary matrix: personal scratchpad ≠ company corpus. Handoff to engineering must answer who can read it and who can take it. Failure mode: "context lives in my head"—sharing has not started and you already have a gray copy.

zh: 主場在這裡。誰讀／誰帶走／著作權＝矩陣身份列 × §06 問責格。沒指定 A，共享升級成角色邊界戰。當週先釘兩格 A：揭露範本推行、交付附聲明（D2＋D5＋D6）。
en: This is the home turf. Who reads / who takes / copyright ＝ matrix role row × §06 accountability cell. No named A, and sharing upgrades into a role-boundary fight. This week, pin two A's: roll out the disclosure template, delivery includes a statement (D2＋D5＋D6).

zh: 一人設計／接案把合成用戶與 AI 變體當 POC 武器時，法律常灰：客戶資料進 personal wiki？demo 語料能不能再展示？合約有沒有蒸餾義務？D2／D5 先畫邊—別等爭議才補 frontmatter。
en: When a solo designer / contractor uses synthetic users and AI variants as a POC weapon, the law is often gray: does client data enter a personal wiki? Can demo corpus be shown again? Does the contract impose a distill duty? Draw the line with D2／D5 first—do not wait for a dispute to backfill frontmatter.

zh: Studio／agency 同樣灰，只是戰場在跨 role：誰的 corpus 能帶走、Red Team 跑過的語料算誰的。入門就是 schema workshop + shared decision log—沒有共用 log，D5 寫進合約也執行不動。
en: Studio／agency is equally gray; the fight is cross-role: whose corpus can leave, who owns corpus the Red Team ran. Entry point is a schema workshop + shared decision log. No shared log, and D5 in the contract still cannot execute.

zh:
治理共性
不論團隊規模或組織型態，底層都是同一套 Wiki 與 Schema 機制，僅有切片方式與治理密度的差別。 獨立 PD 最常卡在脈絡留存在腦中、未曾落盤；分工團隊則容易流於多頭馬車，缺乏明確的 Owner 來拍板。 不論哪種情境，核心都在於建立可追溯的7.2 決策日誌。缺乏日誌記載當下的判斷依據，後續在做蒸餾聲明時，內容自然失去憑據、無法落實。
en:
Governance in common
Team size and org type do not change the substrate: the same Wiki and Schema, different slicing and governance density. Solo PDs stall when context stays in the head and never hits disk. Split-role teams stall when too many drivers and no Owner to call it. In both cases the core is a traceable 7.2 decision log. If the log does not record why you judged as you did, a later distill statement has nothing to stand on.

zh:
§03–§07 每段都收在動手／決策兩欄。動手那欄一定要有步驟、標 EPSS—EPSS 3＝「照著做、允許犯錯」；EPSS 4 只 Demo、只點到。沒步驟，對 0–3 就不算帶走。

沒有 M1 會怎樣：聽完覺得「有道理」但手上沒東西可以做。
en:
§03–§07 each close on two columns: hands-on / decision. The hands-on column must have steps, tagged EPSS—EPSS 3＝"follow it, you are allowed to fail"; EPSS 4 is demo only, mention only. No steps, and for 0–3 it does not count as a takeaway.

Without M1: it sounded right and you leave with nothing you can do.

zh:
§04 四步（本機轉錄 → 旅程 prompt → 瀏覽器扮演 → 寫回）全程預錄。現場只講卡點與判斷；③④ 自己跑、自己排錯＝EPSS 4，這堂課不教。

沒有 M2 會怎樣：現場裸跑，網路斷了／模型抽風了，整場垮。
en:
§04 four steps (local transcript → journey prompt → browser-as-user → write-back) are pre-recorded end to end. Live, talk snags and judgments. Running and debugging ③④ yourself ＝ EPSS 4. This class does not teach it.

Without M2: you run it live, the network dies / the model flakes, the room collapses.

zh: 你用了 Design＋Build、screenshot→Figma、合成用戶 POC 這些流程，交付時就要附揭露：用了哪些工具、資料怎麼流、AI 產出比例、誰審核。不是事後補，是流程裡的一步。
en: If you used Design＋Build, screenshot→Figma, synthetic-user POC, delivery must include disclosure: which tools, how data flowed, what share was AI-produced, who reviewed. Not a retrofit. A step inside the process.

zh: M2（Demo 先錄好）跟 M3（用了就揭露）之間有一條橋：demo 跑了什麼流程、用了什麼工具、資料怎麼流，就是 M3 要揭露的內容。下面泳道把這條橋畫出來—也是有人追問「那 Screenshot→Figma／Design＋Build 呢？」時，指回去的那張圖。
en: A bridge sits between M2 (pre-record the demo) and M3 (if you used it, disclose): which process the demo ran, which tools, how data flowed—that is what M3 must disclose. The swimlane below draws that bridge. It is also the slide you point back to when someone asks "what about Screenshot→Figma／Design＋Build?"

zh:
截圖、模板、Prompt 照用—我們不禁。但它們是並排參考，不是起點。講座主線是 UX 文件 → UI：先把「要做哪些頁、哪些模組、使用者怎麼走、誰交接給誰」寫成文件，再進 Design 出畫面。參考文（Replit Design 等）也把流程拆兩段：Design＝畫面原型，Build＝接上資料／登入／付款才可跑。跳過文件直接開畫布，AI 會把沒寫的判斷用幻覺補完—畫面完整，判斷空洞。

下面用同一個案例貫穿：設計一個給國中老師用的「AI 閱卷複核頁」。
en:
Screenshots, templates, Prompts—use them. We do not ban them. They are side-by-side references, not the start. The talk's through-line is UX documents → UI: write "which pages, which modules, how the user walks, who hands off to whom" as documents, then enter Design for the screen. The reference pieces (Replit Design and others) also split the process in two: Design＝screen prototype; Build＝data / login / payment wired, then it can run. Skip the documents and open a canvas, and the AI hallucinates the unwritten judgments—the screen is complete, the judgment is hollow.

One case runs through what follows: design an "AI grading-review page" for middle-school teachers.

zh: 主線「UX 文件 → UI」對位 §03 缺定義幻覺表（page／module／flow／Agent 協作流程／IA）；Design≠Build 對位 Replit Design vs Build 文件。加速 MVP ≠ 跳過審核。案例改編自 Replit 官方 PM 指南示範。
en: Through-line "UX documents → UI" maps to the §03 missing-definition hallucination table (page／module／flow／Agent collaboration flow／IA). Design≠Build maps to the Replit Design vs Build docs. Faster MVP ≠ skip review. Case adapted from Replit's official PM-guide demo.

zh: markdown＝文字版 COT；html＝POC 可視化 view。agent 同時讀兩者整理 schema；Design 多半在後段
en: markdown＝text COT; html＝POC visualization view. The agent reads both and assembles a schema. Design is mostly the back half

zh: ① MacWhisper 語料 → ② 蒸餾 journey-prompt.md（T4）→ ③ Browser-as-User → ④ 腳本寫回 log.md／交付
en: ① MacWhisper corpus → ② distill journey-prompt.md (T4) → ③ Browser-as-User → ④ script writes back to log.md／delivery

zh: 一人 PD（NA-style）vs 分工團隊（亞洲 style）。共用底層 wiki 與 agents；配置 A 最常卡在判斷留存在腦中未曾落盤，配置 B 則因分工界線模糊而缺乏主責 Owner。
en: Solo PD (NA-style) vs split-role teams (Asian-style). Shared wiki and agents underneath. Config A usually stalls because judgment stays in someone's head and never hits disk. Config B stalls because role lines are fuzzy and no Owner is on the hook.

zh: 泳道裡的兩段：Design 道＝出畫面（按鈕能點但沒存 DB），Build 道＝接資料／登入／付款（可跑且要審核）。對位 Replit Design vs Build
en: Two stretches in the swimlane: Design lane＝make the screen (buttons click, nothing hits a DB). Build lane＝wire data / login / payment (it runs, and it needs review). Maps to Replit Design vs Build
